message.content:
This magazine cover image, vertically oriented with a red border on the left, features a monochromatic stone structure resembling a columbarium or a wall with four rectangular niches. Within each niche, a gray-toned human face is carved into the stone, appearing as if trapped or emerging from the rock. The four faces are arranged in a two-by-two grid, separated by vertical stone pillars with carved bulbous details and a horizontal stone lintel.

Large, translucent gray text "TEMPO" spans the top. Above it, white text reads "PUTUSAN LANCUNG PRAPERADILAN NOVANTO" and "SALING SILANG BIAYA UANG ELEKTRONIK." Below the main title is the slogan "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU." The central horizontal lintel bears the text "GADUH JENDERAL GATOT" in a stylized, metallic font. Below the lower niches, white text reads "5.000 SENJATA MILIK SIAPA." At the bottom right, a barcode, price "RP 45.000," and the date "2-8 OKTOBER 2017" are visible. The stone exhibits a rough, weathered texture with visible cracks and chips. The overall color palette is dark blue and gray.
